newsitem.title: UK: UK shares firm as U.S. gains offset UK rate fears.
newsitem.headline: UK shares firm as U.S. gains offset UK rate fears.

text.p: Inflation fears knocked London shares again on Wednesday after the Bank of England's warning that higher interest rates would be needed to control prices wiped out much of the market's early U.S. election-inspired gains, traders said. The quarterly inflation report from the Bank suggested the government's target was likely to be missed with inflation remaining above 2.5 percent and possibly rising above three percent in the next month or so.
Shares immediately lost ground and the FTSE 100, up 25.4 points at the day's best, closed 14.6 points higher at 3,935.7.
